messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'eu-west-1-gpu-pool-2' queue length > 10k, autoscaler hit max_nodes=120, throttling requests. Severity: P1
Evan: seeing huge queue growth, placing incident channel. starting traceroute of allocator graphs.
Priya: confirmed, 12,300 queued requests on pool-2; latency p95 jumping 3x. Some models returning 429s.
Sam: autoscaler logs show repeated scale_up failures: 'quota exceeded' and 'placement constraints could not be satisfied' around 6501012330.
Nina: digging into placement. early hypothesis: MIG templates mismatch causing many nodes to advertise incompatible slice sizes, leads to binpack fragmentation and stranded GPUs.
Evan: any customer-facing impact yet? Jamal (CS): we have two enterprise customers seeing errors in production, one reporting degraded throughput for embeddings pipeline. They asked for ETA.
Evan: copy. Priya, can you post top error patterns and any immediate mitigation?
Priya: posting filtered logs snippet:
```
[allocator] ERR failed_allocate: cannot find node with free mig_profile=a100-7g, required=1, available=0
[autoscaler] WARN scale_up failed: placement_constraints_unsatisfiable
[queue] WARN enqueue 12345 -> throttled=true
```
Sam: looks like ~60% of GPU capacity is stranded on nodes with mig_profile=a100-2g, while the workload requires 7g slices. We recently rolled a MIG template change in eu-west.
Nina: confirming: rollout at 6501011900 replaced node pool with mixed MIGs (2g/7g) but allocator prefers exact-match slices. Bad interaction with binpacker.
Evan: ops plan: 1) stop accepting new low-priority jobs (apply throttle by tag) 2) trigger manual rebalance to consolidate free 7g slices 3) scale up with fallback nodes having full 7g MIGs if quota allows.
Sam: trying throttle: `POST /v1/queues/global/throttle` payload `{ "tag":"non-prod", "rate":0 }` -> applied. Queue growth paused for non-prod.
Priya: contacting cloud console for temporary quota bump request — may take 10-20m.
ops-bot: NOTE: manual rebalance initiated: job realloc-repack-650101 -> target pool eu-west-1-gpu-pool-2.
Nina: starting repack job, but repack is slow due to eviction backoff. Need to temporarily lower eviction_grace to speed moves.
Evan: Sam, can you lower eviction_grace on repack pods? Make sure we keep E2E for active customer tasks.
Sam: lowering eviction_grace to 15s on repack daemonset now.
Priya: cloud replied: quota request is queued; potential approve in 25-30m. No immediate node quota.
Jamal (CS): telling customers: "We're actively rerouting workloads and doing a focused capacity rebalance. Expect improvement in 20-40 minutes; we'll update in 10."
Evan: remote metric: free_7g_slices dropped to 0 at 6501012300. After repack started, free_7g_slices=180 at 6501012420. Queue length trending down from 12.3k -> 4.1k.
Nina: observed one problematic MIG profile: nodepool-template-v2 created many 2g slices due to default MIG sizing policy; allocator compatibility matrix lacked fallback to aggregate smaller slices for single request. Need code fix (allocator fallback) and change migration policy.
Sam: manual scale fallback: we launched 8 on-demand nodes with explicit 7g MIGs from spare regional quota (not counted in main pool). New nodes registered as eu-west-standby-7g-*. Accepting requests now.
Priya: throttling removed for high-priority customers. Non-prod still throttled.
Evan: customer updates: Jamal please send short note once p95 lat < 2s and queue < 500.
Jamal (CS): sent update to affected accounts: "We have applied emergency capacity and are repacking nodes; service is recovering. We'll follow up with RCA."
ops-bot: deployment audit: recent infra commit 6a7b2c changed default MIG template allocation to 'balanced' without updating allocator rules.
Nina: RCA quick notes to capture: - root cause: MIG template change + allocator exact-match logic -> binpacking fragmentation - autoscaler blocked by placement constraints & regional quota -> couldn't scale past 120 nodes - result: stranded GPU slices and queue growth -> throttling and 429s
Sam: mitigation summary: - emergency repack to consolidate 7g slices - launched standby 7g nodes - temporarily reduced eviction_grace - throttled non-prod - rollback MIG template change in staging to validate fix
Evan: on-call handoff: @Priya you're primary for next 4 hours, @Sam you're secondary. Keep this channel for updates.
Priya: acknowledged. will watch queue and autoscaler logs.
Evan: create incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime and infra for full RCA and followups (allocator fallback, MIG template validation, autoscaler guardrails).
Priya: created ticket INF-4768 with links to logs and repack jobs.
Jamal (CS): customers acknowledged, one customer asked for root cause email; I'll coordinate with you for wording.
Evan: good work team. closing temporary incident channel once queue < 500 and all 429s resolved.
Priya: queue 420 at 6501012455, 429 count back to baseline. marking incident as recovering.
Sam: followup actions to put in ticket: add alerts for free_slice_ratio < 0.05, autoscaler failure rate > 3/min, and preflight MIG-template-change check.
Evan: thanks. will do postmortem doc and schedule a followup review with infra tomorrow. :thumbsup:
